deploy-bot: Initiating coordinated deploy wave orbit-2030 -> prod. Services: runtime, api, console. Trigger: tag=orbit-2030 commit=0f3a7c5. Command: `/deploy wave orbit-2030 --env prod --services runtime,api,console --tag orbit-2030`
sofia: ack, watching runtime pool and smoke runners.
mike: added release notes draft -> https://confluence.redwood/relnotes/orbit-2030 :link:
deploy-bot: runtime: rolling to `runtime@v2.3.1` on 3 nodes. Start 2030054323.
leo: api canary started at 10% traffic. p95 baseline captured.
jamie: console rollout hitting intermittent 502s on two hosts, investigating logs.
sofia: hold console for now, proceed with runtime+api if possible. Pin decision pending.
mike: agree with hold. If console failing, better to pin and continue others.
deploy-bot: pausing `console` rollout (manual hold by sofia). Applying pin -> `console:stable-6.9` at 2030054338.
cicd-bot: canary policy: api -> 10% for 5m -> 50% for 5m -> 100% if no regressions.
leo: api metrics look stable at 10% (p95=120ms, errors <0.1%). Proceeding to 50%.
jamie: root cause for console 502 is a lib mismatch (build artifact trimmed). Pushing hotfix build `console@stable-7.0.1-rollback` for QA.
sofia: runtime smoke tests passing on all nodes. Posting quick test log: ```
SMOKE SUMMARY
runtime: PASS x12
api: PASS x6
console: HOLD
```
mike: if console will need hotfix + re-run deploy, let's pin to stable-6.9 for the wave and continue. No rollback for runtime/api.
deploy-bot: pin recorded: console -> stable-6.9 (locked) by sofia at 2030054350. Continuing runtime and api rollout.
leo: api now at 100% after canary ramp. No regressions observed.
jamie: uploaded hotfix artifact to staging and tested, looks green. Will schedule patch wave separate from this major wave.
sofia: summary note: runtime ✅, api ✅, console ⏸️ pinned->stable-6.9 pending hotfix. Change window closed for orbit-2030.
mike: filing brief in #release-summaries and tagging oncall for post-deploy check. Link -> https://confluence.redwood/ops/reports/orbit-2030-summary
deploy-bot: FINAL STATUS: runtime=SUCCESS, api=SUCCESS, console=PINNED->stable-6.9 (partial, paused). Wave orbit-2030 complete for services progressed.
leo: :thumbsup: good run.
sofia: will follow up with console patch wave timeline tomorrow morning (PST).
mike: noted, thanks everyone.
